description: Every natural tail is cofinite; a finite intersection is the tail at the maximum index (zero for the empty family), whereas the intersection of all tails is empty.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.FiltersAndUltrafilters.tails_example :
  (∀ (n : ℕ), Set.Ici n ∈ Filter.cofinite) ∧
    (∀ (t : Finset ℕ), ⋂ n ∈ t, Set.Ici n = Set.Ici (t.sup id)) ∧ ⋂ n, Set.Ici n = ∅
